sources.observation: The figures vary in height and width. Shallow ocular recesses, severe noses and low relief arms mark the stone figures.
The 15 distinct figures, including a single red topknot on the second figure from the right, stand above a wide sloping stone approach.

limitations: Individual statue positions, orientations and dimensions are photographic approximations within the mapped platform. Nearby individually tagged sculptures lie beyond the main row and remain host features.
